messages:
Marta (Product): quick check: prototype for density toggle + approval rail is in staging. main ask: make approving single runs as fast as bulk approves. link: https://staging.redwood/preview/2350001111

Lina (Design): mock shows inline quick-approve on hover + a sticky rail on multi-select. for touch we added a persistent 20px tap target. feedback welcome on placement and contrast.

Sam (Eng): perf note: inline affordance is cheap. rail is simple sticky element. will add a feature flag for per-team default later.

Alex (Accessibility): a11y nits: don't rely on hover. ensure the quick-approve has keyboard focus, aria-label like 'Approve run', and toast uses role=alert. badges must include text e.g., 'Regressions: 2'.

Priya (Research): user insight: reviewers want a visible undo and a way to pin borderline runs. recommend pin action in the rail and 7s undo toast.

Marta (Product): decision: ship row-compressed default, density toggle in header, inline quick-approve with keyboard support, sticky rail for multi-select, pinning, and 7s undo. Lina + Sam to prototype. Alex + Priya will validate a11y and user flow.

Lina (Design): will update mocks with skip-to-rail link and visible focus states. microcopy: 'Approve run', 'Approve selected (n)', 'Run approved — undo'.

Sam (Eng): I'll branch the prototype tomorrow. ETA: 10 days for working preview. will include analytics events: approve_row, approve_rail, pin_run.

Alex (Accessibility): happy to review preview. quick checklist: keyboard reachable approve, aria-live toasts, textual badges, skip-to-rail.

doc-bot: docs stub created: /docs/prompt-sets/approval-rail.md — please add screenshots and keyboard shortcuts.
